metadata.question: Does tropospheric nitrogen dioxide (NO2) levels in Taiwan increase during April 20-May 12, 2020 compared to February 10-25, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI for NO2 data - Collection: "COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2" - Band: "tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density" or "NO2_column_number_density" - Two periods: Feb 10-25, 2020 and Apr 20-May 12, 2020 - Location: Taiwan (approximate bounds: 120-122°E, 22-25.5°N) 2. Masking strategy: - Sentinel-5P has a quality assurance band (qa_value) - Mask pixels with qa_value < 0.5 for reliable measurements - Also check for cloud coverage if needed 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Check collection size for both periods - Check pixel counts after masking - Valid NO2 values should be in range (typically 0-1e-3 mol/m²) - Compare mean values: if Apr-May > Feb, answer A; otherwise B - Handle C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (invalid calculation) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const taiwan = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([120.0, 22.0, 122.0, 25.5]); const period1Start = '2020-02-10'; const period1End = '2020-02-26'; const period2Start = '2020-04-20'; const period2End = '2020-05-13'; // 2. Data Acquisition const s5p = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); const col1 = s5p.filterDate(period1Start, period1End) .filterBounds(taiwan); const col2 = s5p.filterDate(period2Start, period2End) .filterBounds(taiwan); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Period 1 (Feb 10-25) Images: ${size1}`); console.log(`Period 2 (Apr 20-May 12) Images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("Missing data for one or both periods."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Apply quality mask and calculate means function maskQuality(image) { const qa = image.select('qa_value'); const mask = qa.gte(0.5); return image.updateMask(mask); } const s5pQA = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2'); const col1QA = s5pQA.filterDate(period1Start, period1End) .filterBounds(taiwan) .map(maskQuality) .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); const col2QA = s5pQA.filterDate(period2Start, period2End) .filterBounds(taiwan) .map(maskQuality) .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); const mean1 = col1QA.mean(); const mean2 = col2QA.mean(); // 4. Calculate statistics const stats1 = mean1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: taiwan, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2 = mean2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: taiwan, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const val1 = stats1.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean').getInfo(); const count1 = stats1.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count').getInfo(); const val2 = stats2.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean').getInfo(); const count2 = stats2.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count').getInfo(); console.log(`Period 1 Mean NO2: ${val1}, Valid Pixels: ${count1}`); console.log(`Period 2 Mean NO2: ${val2}, Valid Pixels: ${count2}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after quality masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (val1 === null || val2 === null || isNaN(val1) || isNaN(val2)) { console.log("Calculation returned invalid values."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (val1 < 0 || val2 < 0 || val1 > 1 || val2 > 1) { console.log("NO2 values out of expected range."); console.log("C3"); return; } const increase = val2 > val1; const percentChange = ((val2 - val1) / val1 * 100).toFixed(2); console.log(`Change: ${percentChange}%`); if (increase) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
